dogecoin.text: Dogecoin's market cap is creeping up on Coinbase.  This isn't a drill, people.  Target acquired.  Buckle up.

So, Dogecoin 4x'd in a week.  That's cute.  Still doesn't make it a viable investment, but congrats on becoming overnight millionaires, I guess.  Meanwhile, I'll stick to projects that aren't based on a dog meme.
Dogecoin to a dollar? Sure, right after I buy my beachfront property on Mars.  This pump's giving me 2021 flashbacks, and we all know how that ended. Don't say I didn't warn ya.
Dogecoin pumping?  Great. Another reminder that a dog meme has more market cap than my common sense.  This is fine. Everything's fine.  Just don't ask me about my portfolio.
Dogecoin 4x'd?  So, a digital dog token based on a meme is outperforming actual projects?  This market makes less sense than a cryptobro explaining NFTs to his grandma.
Dogecoin pumping again. So predictable. It's like watching a washed-up boy band try to make a comeback tour... every year.  This time it's different though, right?  Right?
One Dogecoin = Three United States Dollars?  Sure, buddy.  Just like my beanie baby collection is my retirement fund.  Keep dreaming, Dogefather devotees.
Dogecoin showing remarkable strength, possibly hinting at a significant move towards new all-time highs.  Is another major DOGE pump on the horizon?  Time will tell.
Dogecoin's parabolic rise is a classic example of market exuberance.  While exciting, it's a reminder that fundamentals eventually matter.  Don't get caught holding the bag when the music stops.
Dogecoin continues to dominate the memecoin space.  Is it the alpha dog, or just the loudest bark in the kennel?  What memecoins are you watching?
